**Finding: MISSING (critical) — no indemnification article in the Agreement.**

- Section 20 (Indemnification) has been dropped entirely: the outline runs from §19 Warranties straight to §21 Limitation of Liability, and no "indemnify", "defend" or "hold harmless" language exists anywhere.
- Four provisions nonetheless presuppose it: §9.3 conditions termination on Vendor's inability to provide "the remedies required by Section 20.5"; §19.4 preserves remedies for "indemnified claims"; §21.3 lists "indemnification obligations" as Excluded Claims; §30.5 preserves "vested indemnity rights".
- With no Vendor IP indemnity at all, this sits in walk-away territory under the rule, not merely below the fallback.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted: a new Section 20 inserted after §19.5 containing the preferred Vendor defence/indemnity (IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), customary exclusions (Customer modifications, combinations, Customer specifications), procure/modify/replace/refund remedies at 20.5 (repairing the §9.3 cross-reference), standard notice-control-cooperation procedure with a settlement-consent protection, and a narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
